what_this_is: Scan cycles whose published scores were built on much less company data than normal. The rows in `predictions` for these snapshot dates are sealed and have not been changed; this file is how an analysis of the track record finds them. See docs/DATA_INCIDENT_2026-09-11.md.
affected: value and quality factor inputs (Yahoo company info), and so the composite alpha score, signal and cap tier. Momentum inputs were unaffected.
not_affected: momentum (price history), and the Piotroski inputs, which come from financial statements rather than company info.
open: Cycles after 2026-09-13 have not been assessed yet. Add each one the nightly check marks red on fundamentals coverage.
